title: Scribbled Notes
summary: Read and pass DC 15 Investigation to advance the Adamantine Forge quest.

fields.Use: The party attempts DC 15 Investigation. Success reveals the guardian’s magma and hot hammer weakness. Passing checks on these notes, Memory Shard and The Great Furnace of Grymforge earns If I Can’t Have It… for a Sage.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
